project.name: QLPK-SaaS
project.status: Hardened Multi-Tenant Performance & Instant Medicine Search Ready

tech_stack.frontend: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Framer Motion 12
tech_stack.backend: Next.js Server Actions, Supabase PostgreSQL, Supabase MCP
tech_stack.database: PostgreSQL 17 (Supabase) with pg_trgm, unaccent, Atomic Rollups & RPCs
tech_stack.ai: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite (Two-Step Architecture: Search + Format)
tech_stack.infrastructure: Vercel (Region icn1 - Seoul), Supabase (ap-northeast-2), GitHub Actions

security_status.rls: Strict tenant isolation on patients, medicines, prescriptions, and statistics
security_status.multi_tenancy: Clinic-scoped uniqueness (clinic_id, LOWER(name_normalized), dob) and explicit clinic_id checks in all RPCs
security_status.auth_dedup: app_metadata.clinic_id prioritized in getAuthUser() to avoid N+1 queries to profiles table

performance_features.infra_latency: Vercel serverless region aligned to icn1 (Seoul) with Supabase Seoul region
performance_features.prescription_concurrency: Consolidated create_prescription RPC with single-pass atomic header + detail insertion and O(1) daily stats upsert
performance_features.statistics_consolidation: Consolidated get_dashboard_statistics_v2 RPC reducing 14-query waterfall into single database call
performance_features.instant_medicine_search: Zero-latency in-memory client catalog cache (useSyncExternalStore) with Vietnamese multi-token unaccented filtering, deduplicated concurrent requests, and automated mutation invalidation
performance_features.medicine_usage_aggregation: Fast indexed patient medicine usage rollup ordered by times_prescribed DESC

api_endpoints.description: Cung cấp toàn bộ danh mục thuốc active của phòng khám cho client-side cache engine useMedicineCatalog.
Tổng hợp lịch sử dùng thuốc của bệnh nhân (tên, quy cách, số lần kê) với cơ chế tự động fallback clinic_id.
api_endpoints.security: Tenant-isolated by clinic_id, security definer, search_path explicitly set.

api_endpoints.description: Tìm kiếm thuốc có dấu và không dấu bằng pg_trgm + unaccent, giới hạn 20 bản ghi.
Tổng hợp toàn bộ chỉ số KPI, biểu đồ doanh thu, cơ cấu bệnh nhân, top thuốc chỉ trong 1 lệnh gọi.
Tạo đơn thuốc nguyên khối (header + details), cập nhật tồn kho và rollup stats trong 1 transaction.
api_endpoints.security: Tenant-isolated by clinic_id, concurrency lock FOR NO KEY UPDATE on medicines.

api_endpoints.description: Tra cứu liều dùng thuốc bằng AI với bảo mật chống Prompt Injection.

gotchas.issue: Client-side Invalidation Call Compatibility with Sync/Async Mocks
gotchas.solution: Wrap client cache invalidation calls in Promise.resolve(invalidateMedicineCatalog?.()).catch(() => {}) so mock functions returning undefined or void in test runners do not throw TypeError.

gotchas.issue: Cascade Delete vs Blanket Delete in Vitest Cleanup Hooks
gotchas.solution: Never use adminClient.from('child_table').delete().neq('id', 0) in tests as it wipes real production/live data. Instead, delete the test parent record (e.g., prescriptions_header by test clinic_id) and allow PostgreSQL foreign key ON DELETE CASCADE to cleanly remove child records.

gotchas.issue: Supabase Rest Pagination Limit on Data Export
gotchas.solution: Supabase REST API caps results at 1,000 items per request by default. Complete backups and restorations must query in paginated ranges (0..999, 1000..1999) using .range() until empty to avoid omitting records.

gotchas.issue: RPC Authorization Fallback when get_my_clinic_id() is NULL
gotchas.solution: When calling RPCs through diverse client tokens or service roles where auth.jwt() lacks app_metadata, fallback to resolving clinic_id directly from the parent resource (e.g. patients table) to prevent false-negative access rejections.

gotchas.issue: Cross-timezone Date Mismatch in Vitest vs PostgreSQL
gotchas.solution: When asserting clinic_daily_stats date, avoid new Date().toISOString() (UTC). Use new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA', { timeZone: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' }) to match database timezone.

gotchas.issue: Supabase MCP Client Destructive Statement Cancellation
gotchas.solution: Supabase MCP automatically prompts for confirmation on DROP/DELETE statements and may cancel in non-interactive clients. Execute atomic DDL through admin helper RPC with service role key if needed.

gotchas.issue: Client-side Autocomplete Race Conditions in Rapid Typing
gotchas.solution: Track sequence ID (latestRequestId.current) on client and discard any server action responses where response requestId < latestRequestId.

gotchas.issue: Multi-tenancy Patient Unique Key Conflict Across Clinics
gotchas.solution: Unique constraint on patients MUST include clinic_id: (clinic_id, LOWER(name_normalized), COALESCE(dob, '')) so different clinics can treat patients with identical names/birthdays.

gotchas.issue: Multiple Permissive Policies on PostgreSQL RLS
gotchas.solution: Avoid combining FOR ALL with FOR SELECT for the same role; split admin policies into FOR INSERT, FOR UPDATE, FOR DELETE to prevent PostgreSQL evaluating multiple OR conditions per row on SELECT.

gotchas.issue: High-Frequency CountUp Animation React Re-render Thrashing
gotchas.solution: Bypass React Virtual DOM reconciliation by updating spanRef.current.textContent directly in Framer Motion animate onUpdate callback and using a singleton Intl.NumberFormat instance.
